title: Measurable relative orientation on a C¹ antilipschitz chart: JΦ·ξ(Φ) = σ·simpleNVector(∂Φ) with σ = ±1 (step 6c)
statement: Let P, k ∈ ℕ, let U ⊆ ℝ^P be open, and let (M, θ, ξ) satisfy IsRectifiableTriple U k M θ ξ (H^k = μHE[k] on ℝ^P). Let Φ : ℝ^k → ℝ^P be C¹ and c-antilipschitz on an open set Ω ⊆ ℝ^k for some c > 0. Write ∂_bΦ(w) := DΦ(w)e_b (DΦ(w) = fderiv ℝ Φ w, e_b = EuclideanSpace.single b 1), ∂Φ(w) := (∂_0Φ(w), …, ∂_{k−1}Φ(w)) and JΦ(w) := √det(⟨∂_aΦ(w), ∂_bΦ(w)⟩)_{a,b}. Then there is σ : ℝ^k → ℝ, a.e.-strongly measurable for L^k⌞(Ω ∩ Φ⁻¹(M)) (L^k = volume), such that for L^k-a.e. w ∈ Ω ∩ Φ⁻¹(M): σ(w) ∈ {1, −1} and JΦ(w)·ξ(Φ(w)) = σ(w)·simpleNVector(∂Φ(w)).
lean_statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (U M : Set (Eucl P)) (θ : Eucl P → ℝ) (ξ : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) k) (Φ : Eucl k → Eucl P) (Ω : Set (Eucl k)), IsOpen U → IsRectifiableTriple U k M θ ξ → IsOpen Ω → ContDiff ℝ 1 Φ → (∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ w ∈ Ω, ∀ w' ∈ Ω, c * ‖w - w'‖ ≤ ‖Φ w - Φ w'‖) → ∃ σ : Eucl k → ℝ, AEStronglyMeasurable σ ((volume : Measure (Eucl k)).restrict (Ω ∩ Φ ⁻¹' M)) ∧ ∀ᵐ w ∂((volume : Measure (Eucl k)).restrict (Ω ∩ Φ ⁻¹' M)), (σ w = 1 ∨ σ w = -1) ∧ Real.sqrt (Matrix.of fun i j => inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ Φ w (EuclideanSpace.single i 1)) (fderiv ℝ Φ w (EuclideanSpace.single j 1))).det • ξ (Φ w) = σ w • simpleNVector (fun b => fderiv ℝ Φ w (EuclideanSpace.single b 1))
